method: Whole-file manual reading of UiAppearance.cpp in contiguous ranges through EOF; source review only, without Windows rendering or fault injection.
findings: Font lookup cache is cleared on nonzero oldPercent; a separate LOGFONT-keyed owning cache retains font objects so existing control handles remain valid. Static maps assume serialized UI use; lifetime retention is not bounded by current lookup entries.

Menu conversion preserves original item data/type/bitmap and excludes existing owner-drawn/special items and shell command ranges. Mnemonics handle escaped ampersands and cycle multiple enabled matches. RTL layout is explicitly applied.

RestoreScaledMenu erases tracked items after attempting native restoration even if SetMenuItemInfo fails. Possible stale native item tokens under failure are a source-level concern, not a reproduced Windows defect.

MenuRef::SetItemInfo changes cached original data/bitmap before calling the native setter; native failure does not roll those cache changes back. Position-based tracking also requires menu mutations to preserve the recorded correspondence.

Scaled check/radio controls use custom geometry outside high contrast and native themed/frame fallback in high contrast. Paint allocation and GDI return failures are mostly unchecked; no visual/accessibility parity established.
Dialog scaling gathers immediate children and batches position changes. Begin/Defer/End failures have no individual-position fallback; scaled dialog size is not clamped here to monitor work area.
Appearance callbacks swallow exceptions in font enumeration, while NotifyAppearanceChanged invokes attached callbacks directly. Thread affinity and failure behavior require runtime qualification.
limits: No original Windows build, rendering, accessibility, fault injection or performance measurement executed. No foreign production code adopted.
Native pHash memory-error investigation remains deferred. Completed repository count remains147/500.
